sites.locator: the broken window opening in the distant upper-left tower beyond the stone terrace
sites.appearance: a dark ruined tower silhouette with one empty window against the blue night sky
changes: Fill the window with a large cyan moon-moth observatory lens held in a rusted stone frame.
Turn the opening into a compact violet star-map portal with a bright crescent-shaped rim.
Place a clearly supported tiny bell tower in the opening, with two large amber magical bells.
Grow a bold fan of luminous blue moonflowers from the broken sill.
Reveal a small root-bound telescope aimed through the window, with one glowing cyan eyepiece.

sites.surface: mossy stone at the foot of the left foreground column
sites.locator: the tiny purple and cyan mushroom cluster beside the base of the tall left stone column
sites.appearance: several small purple and cyan mushrooms rooted in moss at the column base
changes: Replace them with three oversized glowing mushroom lanterns of visibly different heights.
Turn the cluster into a miniature crystal greenhouse with bright cyan panes and a violet roof gem.
Create a compact open geode nest with bold concentric cyan and violet mineral rings.
Add a tiny mossy shrine with an amber doorway, firmly built against the column base.
Replace the cluster with a luminous sleeping salamander-shaped root growth fused to the stone.

sites.surface: freestanding central stone arch on the terrace
sites.locator: the freestanding tan stone arch standing on the central terrace above the water channel
sites.appearance: a weathered two-pillar stone arch with a broken rounded lintel
changes: Transform the arch opening into a large cyan rune-free moon portal with a clear circular interior.
Grow an enormous root-and-crystal chandelier from the lintel, hanging visibly inside the arch.
Turn it into a tiny open-air apothecary stall with three large glowing bottles under the lintel.
Add a broad suspended waterfall curtain inside the arch, falling naturally into the channel below.
Convert the arch into a root-grown astronomical clock with a big violet lens in its opening.

sites.surface: short broken column on the central paving
sites.locator: the short broken stone column standing alone on the central paving to the right of the arch
sites.appearance: a small gray fractured column stump with a flat broken top
changes: Replace the stump with a compact brass astrolabe projecting a strong cyan circular light.
Turn it into a stone bowl moonwell containing a bright miniature starfield.
Grow a dense tiered shelf of blue and violet luminous mushrooms from the broken top.
Add a perched brass courier automaton with two large glass eyes and a tiny flag.
Replace it with a friendly treasure mimic chest, open but firmly seated on the paving.

sites.locator: the broad empty upper-right stone stair and its mossy landing
sites.appearance: a long cool-gray staircase rising toward the right edge under ruined arches
changes: Add a large root-bound crystal brazier on the landing with one floating violet flame.
Create a compact moonlit library cart with an open oversized spellbook and cyan page glow.
Place a small stone dragon egg nest with a bright curled crystal hatchling inside.
Turn the landing into a supported miniature observatory with a broad brass telescope.
Add three tall luminous moonflower bells rooted along the stair edge.

sites.locator: the dense green fern and small purple mushrooms on the far-right stone bank above the water
sites.appearance: a leafy fern cluster growing from a dark mossy ledge beside the right water
changes: Replace the fern cluster with a broad cyan crystal tree carrying a visible violet gemstone canopy.
Grow a compact three-tier waterfall shrine into the bank, each basin glowing differently.
Add a large root-bound firefly lighthouse with a cyan lens and one broad beam.
Turn the bank into a mossy animal-head spring pouring a bright stream into the water.
Create a tiny supported moon-mushroom garden with three giant colorful caps.

sites.surface: lower-left shallow water and lily pads
sites.locator: the lower-left blue water channel with scattered lily pads beside the lantern platform
sites.appearance: calm dark cyan water with small green lily pads and stone reflections
changes: Form one large luminous cyan spiral whirlpool, with displaced lily pads around it.
Grow three enormous open violet-and-blue lotus flowers from the channel.
Reveal a submerged circular ruin with bright non-text geometric moon marks beneath the water.
Add a tiny leaf boat with a bright crystal sail and a bold curved wake.
Create five large glowing spirit fish circling in a readable ring beneath the surface.

sites.surface: lower central water channel below the bridge
sites.locator: the lower central water with lily pads directly beneath the central stone bridge
sites.appearance: a dark water channel under the bridge with several flat green lily pads
changes: Reveal a huge luminous sleeping water-dragon eye contained beneath the surface.
Add a compact floating root island with one oversized violet mushroom and cyan reflection.
Turn the water into a star-water vortex containing a tiny night sky and crescent moon.
Add three translucent cyan spirit frogs leaping in sequence with coherent splashes.
Create a bright forked magical current with two large glowing stepping lilies.

sites.surface: far-right lower water niche below the fern bank
sites.locator: the narrow dark water niche at the far lower-right edge under the fern-covered ledge
sites.appearance: a shadowed blue water pocket with stone blocks and small purple lights
changes: Add an open stone flower holding a large amber magical flame at its center.
Place a compact moonwell bowl with a visible starfield and hovering cyan crescent.
Reveal a bright crystal koi nest with three large faceted fish in the niche.
Build a tiny root-and-brass beacon with three unfolded cyan crystal panels.
Create a small suspended lantern terrarium with three glowing moon mushrooms.

sites.surface: upper-center distant ruins behind the terrace wall
sites.locator: the tall cyan mushroom group growing in the distant upper-center ruins behind the terrace wall
sites.appearance: a small cluster of narrow glowing cyan mushrooms silhouetted against the night ruins
changes: Replace it with a tall moonflower observatory whose petals frame a bright violet lens.
Turn it into a compact floating-looking but stone-supported crystal radio with tuning rings.
Add a tiny blue moth shrine beneath a clear stone arch in the distant ruins.
Replace the cluster with a bold crescent-shaped caged firefly nest.
Grow a miniature root-built wind chime with two clearly glowing bells.
